rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something is divided or allocated in equal amounts.

example.english: They divide the gifts evenly among six people, giving each person three.
example.traditional: 啲禮物平均咁分畀六個人，每人三份。
example.jyutping: di1 lai5 mat6 ping4 gwan1 gam2 fan1 bei2 luk6 go3 jan4 mui5 jan4 saam1 fan6

rows.note: Use this for spreading something smoothly and uniformly, or for a distribution with no noticeable unevenness rather than simply stressing equal shares.

example.english: Spread the paint evenly over the wooden board.
example.traditional: 將啲油漆均勻咁搽喺塊木板上。
example.jyutping: zoeng1 di1 jau4 cat1 kwan1 wan4 gam2 caa4 hai2 faai3 muk6 baan2 soeng6

rows.note: Use this mathematical construction to say that a number can be divided by N with no remainder.

example.english: Twenty-four can be divided evenly by six.
example.jyutping: ji6 sap6 sei3 bei2 luk6 ceoi4 dak1 zeon6
